📊 Upload Full Method by Excel (.xlsx / .csv) → Generate New Method Tab

Select an Excel Workbook (.xlsx) or CSV (.csv) Method File
Parses multi-sheet Excel files directly in your browser, auto-detects columns (Compound, RT, Formula, Exact Mass, [M+H]+, Mix, Box, LODs), and cross-links every compound to the 2026 Standards Inventory.
🔗 Auto-Detected Column Mapping (Adjust any column dropdown if needed)

🧬 Upload Spectral Library File (.lbp / .sdf)

Select a SCIEX LibraryView / SCIEX OS Binary Library (.lbp) or Structure-Data File (.sdf)
Parses binary SQL CE 3.5 .lbp packages and .sdf spectral libraries directly in your browser — extracting Compound Names, Formulas, Exact Masses, Precursor m/z, Library RTs, Collision Energies, and High-Resolution MS/MS Centroid Spectra.
